summary: Done.ai Group AB provides business systems and financial services platform to small, medium, and large companies through cloud-based services and software as a service. It offers production and inventory, marketing, CRM, recruiting, financial services, and fintech solutions. The company was formerly known as 24SevenOffice Group AB (publ) and changed its name to Done.ai Group AB in April 2025. Done.ai Group AB was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.
